Create `solution.py` with a top-level function `extract_preload_and_image_links(document)` using only the standard library.

`document` must be a string containing HTML-like markup; otherwise raise `TypeError`. Collect the trimmed `src` value from every `img` element and the trimmed `href` value from every `link` element whose whitespace-separated `rel` tokens include `preload`, case-insensitively. Ignore missing and empty attributes. Remove exact duplicate URLs while preserving their first-document order. Relative references must remain unchanged. Parsing incomplete or malformed markup must return whatever links the standard-library parser can recover rather than raising a custom parsing error. Return a new list and retain no mutable alias to caller data.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.

import unittest from solution import extract_preload_and_image_links class ExtractLinksTests(unittest.TestCase): def test_collects_in_document_order_and_deduplicates(self): document = """ """ self.assertEqual( extract_preload_and_image_links(document), ["/early.css", "images/a.png", "/upper.png", "relative/data.json"], ) def test_ignores_missing_and_trimmed_empty_attributes(self): document = ( "" "" "" ) self.assertEqual(extract_preload_and_image_links(document), []) def test_rel_is_split_on_whitespace_and_matching_is_case_insensitive(self): document = "" self.assertEqual(extract_preload_and_image_links(document), ["asset.css"]) def test_relative_and_fragment_references_are_not_resolved(self): document = "" self.assertEqual(extract_preload_and_image_links(document), ["../a.png", "#fragment"]) def test_recovers_from_incomplete_markup(self): document = "
" self.assertEqual(extract_preload_and_image_links(document), ["a.png", "b.css"]) def test_requires_string_and_returns_fresh_lists(self): for malformed in (None, b"", [""]): with self.subTest(malformed=malformed): with self.assertRaises(TypeError): extract_preload_and_image_links(malformed) first = extract_preload_and_image_links("") second = extract_preload_and_image_links("") self.assertIsNot(first, second) first.append("changed") self.assertEqual(second, ["a"]) if __name__ == "__main__": unittest.main()
